title: The Door That Was Never There
description: A quiet house hides something new. #shorts #horror #mystery

scenes.narration: There is a door in my hallway that was not there yesterday.
scenes.image_prompt: narrow dim hallway with an old wooden door that should not exist

scenes.narration: It is small. Painted white. Cold air breathes out from underneath it.
scenes.image_prompt: close view of a small white door with mist on the floor

scenes.narration: I measured the wall. Eleven inches of nothing behind it.
scenes.image_prompt: hand holding a tape measure against a wall
knuckles about to knock on the small white door
the white door slightly trembling in dim light

scenes.narration: I stepped away, and the knocking stopped. Then my phone lit up.
scenes.image_prompt: phone glowing on a dark table, hallway behind

scenes.narration: A text from my own number. Open the door. It is cold in here.
scenes.image_prompt: phone screen close up in darkness

scenes.narration: I did not open it. But at night, I hear it getting closer to the bedroom.
scenes.image_prompt: dark bedroom doorway with faint cold light beneath a small door

scenes.narration: There is a door in my hallway that was not there yesterday.
scenes.image_prompt: narrow dim hallway with an old wooden door that should not exist
